# Scenario library

<!-- Generated by tools/webkit/scada/sim/generate-scenario-docs.py -->

Generated scenario map. Edit the [canonical JSON catalog](index.json) or the local system/model JSON for facts; edit the [documentation generator](https://github.com/Valpatel/cad-agent/blob/dev/tools/webkit/scada/sim/generate-scenario-docs.py) for layout. Run `npm --prefix tools/webkit/scada run docs:scenarios` from the source repository. Check freshness with `npm --prefix tools/webkit/scada run docs:scenarios:check`; do not hand-edit this output.

[Package map](../README.md) · [Model API](../docs/MODEL-API.md) · [Runnable Explorer](../../explorer/README.md) · [Image gallery](../img/README.md) · [Topology SVGs](../img/topologies/README.md)

The 61 scenario folders pair a UI system description with a separate illustrative
model. Model contracts: v1: 21; v2: 40. Every focused view
within a scenario observes the same model session.


| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| [index.json](index.json) | Discovery catalog, system/model paths, search tags, views, structural reference IDs and experiment command recipes |
| `<scenario>/system.json` | Equipment IDs, types/variants, ports, connections, layouts, bindings, controls and provenance |
| `<scenario>/model.json` | Versioned model roles, parameters, initial state, circuit/energy assumptions and editable limits |
| `<scenario>/README.md` | Local map, compact equipment-symbol SVG topology, model-role table, captured thumbnail and experiment summary |

Experiments live in `index.json`, not in separate files. Thumbnails belong to
[the model package gallery](../img/README.md); symbol art belongs to the sibling
[SCADA UI gallery](../../ui/img/README.md). Do not copy either into a host app.

The [topology SVGs](../img/topologies/README.md) reuse those equipment symbols in
compact schematics of each first focused view. They show declared relationships
with illustrative icon states; captured thumbnails separately show a model state.
Use `npm --prefix tools/webkit/scada run topologies:generate` in the source repository to regenerate the SVGs
from their canonical inputs, or `npm --prefix tools/webkit/scada run topologies:check` to check for drift.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Catalog[Scenario catalog] --> System[System JSON and named views]
  Catalog --> Model[Versioned model JSON]
  Model --> Session[One headless model session]
  System --> Views[Shared SCADA viewer]
  Session -->|snapshots| Views
  Views -->|commands via adapter| Session
```

[Open the complete contact sheet](../img/thumbnails/contact-sheet.jpg), or browse
the scenario thumbnails below.

## Change or add an example

Start from a scenario using the required model version. Preserve stable equipment
IDs across the system and model; define resource domains, supplies and observations
explicitly for v2. Keep guessed numbers and unsupported behaviors in assumptions.
Add discovery metadata and finite command recipes to the catalog, then regenerate the
local map with `npm --prefix tools/webkit/scada run docs:scenarios`. The [model contract](../docs/MODEL-API.md), [schemas](../schema/README.md)
and [integration guide](../docs/INTEGRATION.md) describe the boundaries.

Use the owning [test workflows](https://github.com/Valpatel/cad-agent/blob/main/tests/webkit/scada/sim/README.md) and a real Explorer session to
review changed behavior, including failure and repair. Keep preview generation
separate from generated documentation; root build tooling coordinates deployment and
portable outputs. No schema or thumbnail substitutes for engineering validation.
